description.en: Evidence-informed genus-level whole-organism reconstruction: stalkless globular plated cup and long branching arms. Complete distal arms, size, repeated counts, pose and palette are artistic. Free-floating behaviour, exact complete specimen proportions and a particular living habitat are not asserted.
